title: Recovering Sign Regions of Conditional Effects in Binary Instrumental Variable Models
banked_reason: D0.5.G cold referee: delivered tier=incremental below floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 4.3 < field threshold 7.4, with no unrepaired correctness finding.
gap_reasons: No estimator recovers the labeled graph over the full class, and neither matched Hausdorff rates nor a necessary-and-sufficient incidence threshold is proved.
Existing multi-field excursion theory already covers much of the sandwich construction, leaving the legal chart and narrow face-label test as the principal delivered novelty.
The framing accurately identifies the frontier as open, but that unresolved result and the lack of a demonstrated application constrain the projected leading-journal score.
proof_attempt_summary: The run constructed honest sign sandwiches, a conservative known-support Hausdorff upper bound, a legal observed-data IV chart, and a dimension-general compatible-ball converse showing the necessary face-gap channel n(lambda_n r_0^nu)^2 -> infinity. Three maximality rounds strengthened the original restricted two-law witness but could not supply a full-class labeled-graph estimator, a same-class localized spatial packing, matched Hausdorff rates, or thresholds for the other signal scales. Both correctness panels passed; the sound package was downgraded because those missing results are the central field-level program rather than bounded repairs.
tldr: What sample size and signal gaps permit recovery of the locations and exact binding causal face labels of positive, negative, and ambiguous conditional effects in a legal binary IV model? This note proves simultaneous sign sandwiches, a conservative known-support Hausdorff upper bound, and a full-class necessary face-gap condition on compatible ball supports in every fixed dimension. Matched minimax rates and the necessary-and-sufficient exact-incidence frontier remain open.
gap: Conditional sharp IV endpoints and generic multi-field excursion sandwiches are established; a matched legal-IV location and exact finite face-labeled incidence frontier is unresolved.
fill: Determine necessary and sufficient scales for exact finite predicate-graph recovery and matched Hausdorff rates under one known-support legal-IV class, after testing transverse crossings and legal localized packings.
